rss: There's a crackdown on sports piracy - but is it already out of control?
title: Game Makers Fight Piracy
story: Some kids are using sneaky tricks to play video games without paying. This makes it hard for game makers to earn money. They are working hard to stop this.
storyBig: Game developers face challenges from illegal game copying, impacting their revenue streams. Efforts are underway to curb these activities and protect the industry's financial health.
think: Why is it important to pay for video games?
bull: More kids might buy video games, helping game makers.
bear: If tricks continue, game makers might lose money.

rss: Turning the tides: Could hidden sea power energise our coastal towns?
title: New Tidal Power for BizKid Towns
story: A new way to use ocean waves can help power towns by the sea. This could mean cleaner energy and more fun at the beach!
storyBig: Tidal energy is emerging as a promising renewable resource, offering coastal towns a sustainable power solution. This innovation could lead to eco-friendly growth in regions by the sea.
think: How can the ocean help us make energy?
bull: Tidal power could make energy cleaner and cheaper.
bear: It might take time to build these new power machines.
